# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assesing change in EVI from 2010-2020
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)

kaza_valid_area <- vect(here("outputs", "kaza_valid_area.gpkg"))
etosha_vect <- vect(etosha_pts, geom = c("x2_", "y2_"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
etosha_valid_area <- buffer(convHull(etosha_vect), width = 50000)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variation in EVI
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# load libraries
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
# ------------------

# load data
evi_folder <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")

build_evi_season <- function(season) {
  if (season == "dry") {
    years <- 2008:2020
    paths <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", years, ".tif"))
  } else {
    years <- 2008:2021   # labelled by end year, as in resistance_surface.Rmd
    paths <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", years - 1, "_", years, ".tif"))
  }
  r <- rast(paths) / 10000   # rescale to true EVI
  names(r) <- years
  time(r)  <- years
  r
}

evi <- map(c("dry", "wet"), build_evi_season) |> set_names(c("dry", "wet"))
evi$dry   # check nlyr, extent, CRS, min/max (should now be ~0-0.4)
# -------------------

# change over time (per season)
evi_change <- map(evi, \(r) r[[nlyr(r)]] - r[[1]])          # last year - first year
evi_mean   <- map(evi, \(r) app(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE))      # average per pixel
evi_trend  <- map(evi, \(r) regress(r, time(r))[[2]])        # slope = EVI change per year
# -------------------

# plotting change
plot(rast(evi_change), main = c("Dry: last - first", "Wet: last - first"),
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdYlGn"))   # red = decline, green = gain
plot(rast(evi_mean),   main = c("Dry: mean EVI", "Wet: mean EVI"))
plot(rast(evi_trend),  main = c("Dry: trend per year", "Wet: trend per year"),
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdYlGn"))
# -------------------

# plotting time series
evi_ts <- map_dfr(evi, \(r) global(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE) |>
                    mutate(year = time(r)), .id = "season")

# overall min and max EVI across all pixels, years, and seasons
evi_range <- map(evi, \(r) minmax(r, compute = TRUE)) |>
  unlist() |> range(na.rm = TRUE)
evi_range

# plot of mean EVI per year split by wet and dry seasons
evi_change_plot <- ggplot(evi_ts, aes(year, mean, colour = season)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = evi_range) +
  labs(y = "Mean EVI", x = "Year")
evi_change_plot

# plot of mean EVI per year split by wet and dry seasons and 1 SD
evi_ts_sd <- map_dfr(evi, \(r) {
  data.frame(year = time(r),
             mean = global(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE)$mean,
             sd   = global(r, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)$sd)
}, .id = "season")

evi_change_plot_sd <- ggplot(evi_ts_sd, aes(year, mean, fill = season, colour = season)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "Mean EVI (± 1 SD across pixels)", x = "Year")
evi_change_plot_sd

# summarize how much a multi-year stack changes over time with pearson's r
summarise_change <- function(r) {
  cors <- layerCor(r, "pearson", na.rm = TRUE)
  cors <- if (is.list(cors)) cors$correlation else cors
  cors <- cors[upper.tri(cors)]

  temporal_sd <- global(app(r, sd, na.rm = TRUE), mean, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]  # avg per-pixel SD over time
  spatial_sd  <- mean(global(r, sd, na.rm = TRUE)$sd)                       # avg SD across pixels per year

  yr_means <- global(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE)$mean

  tibble(
    min_cor_between_years = min(cors),
    mean_cor_between_years = mean(cors),
    temporal_to_spatial_sd = temporal_sd / spatial_sd,
    pct_change_in_mean = (last(yr_means) - first(yr_means)) / first(yr_means) * 100
  )
}
# run on both seasons
change_tbl <- map_dfr(evi, summarise_change, .id = "variable") |>
  mutate(variable = paste0("evi_", variable))
change_tbl

# crop to etosha
evi_etosha <- map(evi, \(r) r |> crop(etosha_valid_area) |> mask(etosha_valid_area))
evi_kaza <- map(evi, \(r) r |> crop(kaza_valid_area) |> mask(kaza_valid_area))
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assessing land cover chnage from 2008-2020
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variation in land cover
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# load libraries
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
# ------------------

# set up (same classes as resistance_surface.Rmd)
lc_dist_folder <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
lc_types <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")
years    <- 2008:2020   # years produced by ESA_landcover.Rmd
# ------------------

# load data: one SpatRaster per class, one layer per year
build_lc_dist_class <- function(lc_type) {
  paths <- file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc_type, "_", years, ".tif"))
  missing <- years[!file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    warning("Missing ", lc_type, " for: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  r <- rast(paths[file.exists(paths)])
  names(r) <- years[file.exists(paths)]
  time(r)  <- years[file.exists(paths)]
  r
}

lc_dist <- map(lc_types, build_lc_dist_class) |> set_names(lc_types)
lc_dist$cropland   # 13 layers named 2008 ... 2020
# ------------------

# land cover change analysis
lc_trend  <- map(lc_dist, \(r) regress(r, time(r))[[2]])   # metres per year
lc_change <- map(lc_dist, \(r) r[["2020"]] - r[["2008"]])

lc_ts <- map_dfr(lc_dist, \(r) global(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE) |>
                   mutate(year = time(r)), .id = "class")
# ------------------

# plotting mean distance per year
lc_change_plot <- ggplot(lc_ts, aes(year, mean / 1000, colour = class)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "Mean distance to class (km)", x = "Year")
lc_change_plot

lc_change_by_type_plot <- ggplot(lc_ts, aes(year, mean / 1000)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "Mean distance to class (km)", x = "Year")
lc_change_by_type_plot
# ------------------

# summarise how much each class changes over time
source(here("code", "summarise_change.R"))   # or paste the function here

lc_change_tbl <- map_dfr(lc_dist, summarise_change, .id = "variable") |>
  mutate(variable = paste0("dist_", variable))
lc_change_tbl

# convert to km for readability
lc_dist_km <- map(lc_dist, \(r) r / 1000)
# ------------------

# change over time (per class)
lc_change <- map(lc_dist_km, \(r) r[[nlyr(r)]] - r[[1]])         # last year - first year (km)
lc_mean   <- map(lc_dist_km, \(r) app(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE))     # average distance per pixel
lc_trend  <- map(lc_dist_km, \(r) regress(r, time(r))[[2]])       # slope = km per year
lc_sd_time <- map(lc_dist_km, \(r) app(r, sd, na.rm = TRUE))      # year-to-year variability per pixel
# ------------------

# plotting change maps
# negative = class got closer (often expansion), positive = class got farther away
plot(rast(lc_change), main = paste0(lc_types, ": last - first (km)"),
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"))
plot(rast(lc_mean),   main = paste0(lc_types, ": mean distance (km)"))
plot(rast(lc_trend),  main = paste0(lc_types, ": trend (km/yr)"),
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"))
plot(rast(lc_sd_time), main = paste0(lc_types, ": SD across years (km)"))
# ------------------

# plotting time series
lc_ts_sd <- map_dfr(lc_dist_km, \(r) {
  data.frame(year = time(r),
             mean = global(r, mean, na.rm = TRUE)$mean,
             sd   = global(r, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)$sd)
}, .id = "class")

# min and max distance per class, across all pixels and years
lc_range <- map_dfr(lc_dist_km, \(r) {
  mm <- minmax(r, compute = TRUE)
  tibble(min = min(mm[1, ]), max = max(mm[2, ]))
}, .id = "class")
lc_range

# mean distance per year, on each class's full min-max range
lc_change_plot <- ggplot(lc_ts_sd, aes(year, mean)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_blank(data = lc_range, aes(x = 2008, y = min), inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # force axis to min
  geom_blank(data = lc_range, aes(x = 2008, y = max), inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # ...and max
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "Mean distance to class (km)", x = "Year")
lc_change_plot

# mean distance per year with ± 1 SD across pixels
lc_change_plot_sd <- ggplot(lc_ts_sd, aes(year, mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ class, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "Mean distance (km, ± 1 SD across pixels)", x = "Year")
lc_change_plot_sd
# ------------------

# summarise how much each class changes over time
lc_change_tbl <- map_dfr(lc_dist_km, summarise_change, .id = "variable") |>
  mutate(variable = paste0("dist_", variable))
lc_change_tbl

# convert to km for readability
lc_dist_km <- map(lc_dist, \(r) r / 1000)

get_cor <- function(r) {
  cors <- layerCor(r, "pearson", na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.list(cors)) cors$correlation else cors
}

lc_cors <- map(lc_dist_km, get_cor)

lc_cor_2008 <- map_dfr(lc_cors, \(m) tibble(year = years, r = m[1, ]), .id = "class")

ggplot(lc_cor_2008, aes(year, r)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ class) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y = "Pearson's r with 2008", x = "Year")

lc_cors <- map(lc_dist_km, get_cor)

# land cover script, same as EVI's change_tbl
lc_change_tbl <- map_dfr(lc_dist_km, summarise_change, .id = "variable") |>
  mutate(variable = paste0("dist_", variable))
lc_change_tbl
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assessing population change from 2008-2020
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variation in population
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# load libraries
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
# ------------------

# load data
gee_folder <- here("data", "500m_data")
years      <- 2008:2020   # match EVI and land cover

pop <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))[[as.character(years)]]
time(pop) <- years
pop   # check nlyr = 13, names 2008 ... 2020, min/max
# -------------------

# change over time
pop_change  <- pop[[nlyr(pop)]] - pop[[1]]            # last year - first year
pop_mean    <- app(pop, mean, na.rm = TRUE)            # average per pixel
pop_trend   <- regress(pop, time(pop))[[2]]            # slope = people per pixel per year
pop_sd_time <- app(pop, sd, na.rm = TRUE)              # year-to-year variability per pixel
# -------------------

# plotting change
plot(pop_change, main = "Population: last - first",
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu", rev = TRUE))         # red = increase, blue = decrease
plot(log10(pop_mean + 1), main = "Mean population (log10 + 1)")
plot(pop_trend, main = "Population trend (per year)",
     col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu", rev = TRUE))
plot(pop_sd_time, main = "Population: SD across years")
# -------------------

# plotting time series
pop_range <- range(minmax(pop, compute = TRUE))
pop_range

pop_ts_sd <- data.frame(year = time(pop),
                        mean = global(pop, mean, na.rm = TRUE)$mean,
                        sd   = global(pop, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)$sd)

# mean population per year
pop_change_plot <- ggplot(pop_ts_sd, aes(year, mean)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "Mean population per pixel", x = "Year")
pop_change_plot

# mean population per year with ± 1 SD across pixels
pop_change_plot_sd <- ggplot(pop_ts_sd, aes(year, mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Mean population per pixel (± 1 SD across pixels)", x = "Year")
pop_change_plot_sd
# -------------------

# summarise how much population changes over time
source(here("code", "summarise_change.R"))   # or paste the function here

pop_change_tbl <- summarise_change(pop) |>
  mutate(variable = "world_pop", .before = 1)
pop_change_tbl
```
